exercises.description: From json module, import dumps. Convert {'status': 'active'} to JSON string and print.
exercises.solution:

data = {'status': 'active'}
result = dumps(data)
print(result)

exercises.title: Boss Challenge: Multi-Module Intelligence System
exercises.description: CLASSIFIED: Build complete intel system. Import 'math', 'random', and 'time'. Calculate: random number 1-10, square root of 25, then print 'SYSTEM READY'. Test all modules!
exercises.solution:
import math
import random
import time

random.randint(1, 10)
math.sqrt(25)
print('SYSTEM READY')
